name: Tessera Keen
seed: Studies routines, impersonates trusted contacts and keeps leverage on clients. Wants anonymity, not Nix’s public recognition.
design: Female jackdaw, charcoal feathers, pale gray eyes, dull olive traveling coat with reversible ochre lining, plain ring.
history: Latchford dispatch assistant who learned whose manners made staff stop checking. Built a career in impersonation and access brokerage.
desire: To remain impossible to pin to one identity while owning everyone else’s secrets.
contradiction: Needs enough recognition from expert peers to risk showing her signature.
relationships: Nix provides public noise; Patch keeps equipment running; Corvin is useful and contemptible.
arc: Her planted D17 test becomes traceable through ordinary human evidence. She sacrifices a profitable identity to escape, leaving a narrower network.
story_engine: Two people claim the same appointment; a witness remembers an act of kindness she thought nobody saw.
writer_truth: D17 is her limited receipt replay via a compromised trade relay, not remote control over the Burrow’s physical gates.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
